title: Underlying set functors for the field-action module lift
statement: Let $k$ be a field with specified separable closure $k^s/k$, put $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $G=\operatorname{Aut}_k(k^s)$, and use the field and action set-sheaf categories of the normalized field-action interface [def-sfb-field-action-topos-normalization]. Let $R$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], with coefficient ring object $R_s=p_s^*R$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Use internal modules [sk-def-sfb-module-objects] and internal action modules [def-sfb-condensed-action-module]. Define three underlying-set functors. The field functor $\operatorname{fieldSets}_R:\operatorname{Mod}_{R_s}\to\operatorname{Sh}(s_{\mathrm{proet}})$ forgets the module structure and then the abelian group structure, retaining the actual sections and restrictions. The action-module functor $\operatorname{actionSets}_R:\mathcal A_G(R)\to\operatorname{Sh}(B,J_B)$ forgets the action and module structure, then the abelian group structure, and transports the resulting condensed set sheaf to the recorded small profinite site. The action-topos functor $\operatorname{actionUnderlying}:\operatorname{Cond}^{\underline G}\to\operatorname{Sh}(B,J_B)$ forgets the internal action and retains the underlying set sheaf. These are the actual forgetful functors; no theorem asserting an equivalence or an adjunction is part of their definition.
